basics.name: Alex Profir
basics.label: Software Engineer
basics.summary: I'm a full stack engineer with 8 years of experience building web and mobile products, from React and React Native apps to Node.js microservices. For the past year and a half I've worked through agentic coding and spec-driven development: I write the specs, orchestrate the agents and own the quality of what ships. On recent projects this cut end-to-end feature delivery from months to weeks. I care about usability and product quality, and I work closely with my team.
